ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: In couple's work, practicing mindfulness includes helping each partner to become more aware of the words they are using with each other and choosing better ones that, rather than push the partner away, restore closeness. They learn to watch their own body language, being mindful of what they're projecting to their partner through how they're sitting or standing, the tone of their voice, the volume [which / at which] they're speaking, and the expressions on their face. It's being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to resolution. It's taking the time to self-soothe, calming themselves back down when they're getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it's the partner's upset that is escalating too far. So, mindfulness is not just self-awareness but also other-awareness.

questions.passage: In couple's work, practicing mindfulness includes helping each partner to become more (A)[ignorant / aware] of the words they are using with each other and choosing better ones that, rather than push the partner away, restore closeness. It's being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and (B)[replacing / reinforcing] them with the paths that actually lead to resolution. It's taking the time to self-soothe, calming themselves back down when they're getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it's the partner's upset that is escalating too far. So, mindfulness is not just self-awareness but also (C)[other-awareness / self-isolation].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 단어에 더 '인식하게' 된다. 건강하지 않은 패턴을 '대체한다'. 마음챙김은 '타인 인식'이기도 하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① aware — replacing — other-awareness: 원문 일치
❌ ② ignorant(무지한)는 원문 aware(인식하는)의 반의어
❌ ③ reinforcing(강화하는)은 원문 replacing(대체하는)과 의미 불일치
❌ ④ self-isolation(자기 고립)은 원문 other-awareness(타인 인식)와 의미 불일치

det.korean: 친밀함을 '회복한다'. '예측 가능한' 건강하지 않은 패턴. 파트너를 '진정시킨다'.

❌ ③ unpredictable(예측 불가능한)은 원문 predictable(예측 가능한)의 반의어
❌ ④ agitate(동요시키다)는 원문 soothe(진정시키다)의 반의어

questions.passage: In couple's work, practicing mindfulness includes helping each partner to become more aware of the words they are using with each other and choosing better ones that, rather than push the partner away, ①<u>restore</u> closeness. They learn to watch their own body language, being ②<u>mindful</u> of what they're projecting to their partner through how they're sitting or standing, the tone of their voice, the volume [which / at which] they're speaking, and the expressions on their face. It's being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to ③<u>resolution</u>. It's taking the time to self-soothe, calming themselves back down when they're getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it's the partner's upset that is ④<u>diminishing</u> too far. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 escalating(확대되는)인데 diminishing(줄어드는)으로 교체. 파트너의 감정이 '확대되고' 있다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① restore(회복하다): 친밀함을 회복한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② mindful(주의 깊은): 무엇을 투영하는지 주의 깊게 살핀다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ resolution(해결): 해결로 이끄는 경로라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ diminishing(줄어드는) → escalating(확대되는): 파트너의 감정이 '지나치게 확대'되고 있는 문맥이므로 diminishing은 부적절

It's being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to ③<u>resolution</u>. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 projecting(투영하는)인데 concealing(숨기는)으로 교체. 앉거나 서는 방식 등으로 파트너에게 '투영'한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① aware(인식하는): 단어에 더 인식하게 된다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② concealing(숨기는) → projecting(투영하는): 몸짓을 통해 파트너에게 '숨기는' 것이 아니라 '투영하는' 것이라는 문맥
✅ ③ resolution(해결): 해결로 이끄는 경로라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ self-awareness(자기 인식): 마음챙김이 자기 인식이라는 문맥에 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 better(더 나은)인데 worse(더 나쁜)로 교체. 파트너를 밀어내지 않고 친밀함을 회복하는 '더 나은' 말을 선택한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① worse(더 나쁜) → better(더 나은): 파트너를 밀어내지 않고 친밀함을 회복하는 말이므로 '더 나은'이 적절. worse는 문맥 모순
✅ ② tone(톤): 목소리의 톤이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ repeat(반복하다): 건강하지 않은 패턴을 반복한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ upset(화난): 화가 나고 있을 때 자기 진정한다는 문맥에 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ④ patterns(패턴): 3번째 문장의 단어로 restore의 목적어로 부적절

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 watch의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

✅ ① (A) 주의하다 — (B) 관찰하다: (A)는 미끄러지지 않도록 '주의'하는 물리적 조심, (B)는 몸짓을 의식적으로 '관찰'하는 성찰적 의미
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B) '시청하다'는 TV 등을 보는 의미로 몸짓 관찰과 불일치
❌ ④ (A) '감시하다'는 watch의 의미이나 미끄러운 길 조심 문맥과 불일치

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the act of finding an answer to a problem or conflict"

det.korean: resolution = 해결 (문제나 갈등에 대한 답을 찾는 행위)
det.analysis:
❌ ① closeness(친밀함): 관계의 가까움이지 문제 해결이 아님
❌ ② awareness(인식): 인지하는 상태이지 문제 해결이 아님
✅ ④ resolution(해결): 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ mindfulness(마음챙김): 주의 집중이지 문제 해결이 아님

questions.passage: They learn to watch their own body language, being mindful of what they're projecting to their partner through how they're __________ (sit) or standing.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

sit → ____

det.korean: 병렬 구조에서 standing과 같은 형태인 현재분사(-ing) 필요.
det.analysis: how they're ___ or standing — be동사(they're) 뒤 진행형 + or standing과 병렬. sit → sitting.
det.tip: 병렬 구조: sitting or standing (현재분사 + or + 현재분사)

questions.passage: It's being aware of the __________ (predict) unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

predict → ____

det.korean: 명사 patterns를 수식하는 형용사 필요. predict → predictable(예측 가능한).
det.analysis: the ___ unhealthy patterns — 관사 the 뒤, 명사 patterns 앞에서 형용사 역할. 예측 가능한 패턴이라는 의미이므로 predict → predictable (형용사 파생 접미사 -able).

questions.passage: In couple's work, practicing mindfulness includes helping each partner to become more aware of the words they are using with each other and choosing better ones that, rather than push the partner away, restore closeness. They learn to watch their own body language, being mindful of what they're projecting to their partner through how they're sitting or standing, the tone of their voice, the volume [which / at which] they're speaking, and the expressions on their face. It's being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to resolution. It's taking the time to __________, calming themselves back down when they're getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it's the partner's upset that is escalating too far. So, mindfulness is not just self-awareness but also other-awareness.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 자기 진정(self-soothe). 화가 나고 있을 때 다시 진정시킨다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① restore closeness(친밀함 회복): 1번째 문장의 표현으로 빈칸 위치의 '감정 진정' 문맥과 불일치
✅ ② self-soothe(자기 진정): calming themselves back down과 동의적 표현으로 문맥에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ repeat patterns(패턴 반복): 앞 문장의 표현으로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
❌ ④ watch body language(몸짓 살피기): 2번째 문장의 표현으로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
det.tip: self-soothe = 자기 진정 (자신의 감정을 스스로 달래는 것)

questions.passage: In couple's work, practicing mindfulness includes helping each partner to become more aware of the words they are using with each other and choosing better ones that, rather than push the partner away, restore closeness. They learn to watch their own body language, being mindful of what they're projecting to their partner through how they're sitting or standing, the tone of their voice, the volume [which / at which] they're speaking, and the expressions on their face. It's being aware of the predictable unhealthy patterns that they continue to repeat in their arguments, and replacing them with the paths that actually lead to resolution. It's taking the time to self-soothe, calming themselves back down when they're getting upset, and also know how to soothe their partner when it's the partner's upset that is escalating too far. So, mindfulness is __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 자기 인식뿐 아니라 타인 인식(not just self-awareness but also other-awareness). 글의 결론 문장.
det.analysis:
❌ ① only about calming oneself(자기 진정에만 관한 것): 글은 'not just self' — '자기만'이 아니라고 함
❌ ② replacing unhealthy patterns(건강하지 않은 패턴 대체): 마음챙김의 한 측면이나 결론 문장과 불일치
❌ ③ just about body language(몸짓에만 관한 것): 마음챙김의 한 측면일 뿐 결론과 불일치
✅ ④ not just self-awareness but also other-awareness: 원문의 결론 — 마음챙김 = 자기+타인 인식
det.tip: not just A but also B = A뿐만 아니라 B도 (마음챙김의 핵심 정의)
